description: Universal direct InvAPI call by resource and action, for resources without typed tools (e.g.: iso — ISO image library, s3 — S3 Object Storage, rhr — Remote Hands new version; see action list in the docs: https://hostkey.com/documentation/apidocs/). ALWAYS requires confirm=true; destructive/paid actions additionally require HOSTKEY_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=1. Prefer typed tools when they exist for the needed operation.

confirm.description: Required confirmation. Without confirm=true the call is rejected.

params.description: Call parameters as an object; nested objects become params[...]

resource.description: InvAPI resource without .php, e.g.: iso, s3, rhr, eq, net, whmcs

name: call_api_raw
